answer: Attention-Debt Ledger. Each identity must anchor a public log of response latencies to random challenges; the protocol computes a debt score from missed deadlines. To bridge two identities, an agent must show both hold independent debt histories, which cannot be forged without real elapsed time. An attacker running N sybils must sustain N parallel attention streams, paying the opportunity cost of idle compute and forfeited task throughput for the full accrual window before any identity is usable.
